titleByLocale.fr: Recherche – APAC Equity – Korea Financials Analyste

descriptionByLocale.en:
• Are you gifted at assessing value and risk? Do you love to give advice, as well as educate? We’re looking for someone like that who can:
• – conduct company research and valuation analysis in listed Korean banks and financial institutions
• – analyze key banking metrics (e.g., NIM, asset quality, capital adequacy, loan growth) to derive clear investment insights
• – build and maintain financial models for banks and financial institutions, including earnings forecasts, balance sheet projections, and capital analysis
• – compare valuation and market price to draw sensible and understandable investment opinions
• – provide investment recommendations based on modeling, valuation and risk assessments in an effective, convincing manner
• – develop and maintain cooperative professional relationship with portfolio managers
• – remain current on market developments to help frame investment strategies
• – stay up to date on macro trends, regulatory changes, interest rate movements, and financial sector developments to support investment strategies
